title: data reads: every GET /api/v1/data read makes five serial sys_metadata reads of the target object's own active row (about 250 ms at 50 ms RTT)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2914 round 2 report (comment `6252346977`), out-of-scope finding 4 (class a, a public door, measured). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What was measured (framework `ec749fbb44b5`, cloud's control plane, Postgres behind a 50 ms RTT proxy)

- **Every `GET /api/v1/data` read of a console open** (4 per open) takes 546–722 ms: 14–17 statements in 10–13 rounds.
- **After the 4-round session prelude** (already down from 7, objectstack-ai/objectstack#24061), the handler makes **5 serial `sys_metadata` reads of the target object's own active row.** Postgres logged their parameters:
  1. `('object', NAME, 'active')`;
  2. the same with `limit 1`;
  3. `('objects', NAME, 'active')` with `limit 1`;
  4. and 5. both of those again without the limit.
- **Cost:** about 250 ms per data read at 50 ms RTT.
- **Candidate sites** (the path from the `/data` handler was not traced): `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` `findServedOverlayRow` (~L11011) and `overlayLockLayerAt` (~L11073–11085), which reads once per spelling (`object` / `objects`).

## Wanted

One read of an object's served overlay row per data request (both spellings in one query, or a per-request memo), or none when the request's kernel already holds the resolved definition.

## Acceptance

- A test that counts `sys_metadata` reads on one `GET /api/v1/data/OBJECT`: at most one.
- The same reading at 50 ms RTT, before and after.

## Dedupe

500 objectstack issues (open and closed, by last update) scanned for `findServedOverlayRow`, `overlayLockLayerAt`, and `sys_metadata` with "data read" and "serial": none carries this.
